item.title: Statement on DEA attempt to reschedule five tryptamines
item.dc:creator: Kevin Cranford
item.description: MAPS opposes the proposed placement of five tryptamines in Schedule I and urges the DEA to hold a hearing. […]
item.content:encoded:
MAPS opposes the proposed placement of five tryptamines in Schedule I and urges the DEA to hold a public hearing before any final rule.

Scheduling would make research on these compounds harder without evidence of a public health need.
